headline: QA-focused signals: CI runner deprecation, shorter retention windows, accessibility standard update, and agentic GUI automation preview

top_signal.title: GitHub Actions: macOS 14 runner image retirement (Nov 2, 2026)
top_signal.summary: GitHub announced retirement of the macOS 14 (Sonoma) Actions runner image effective November 2, 2026, with multiple October brownouts. Workflows should migrate to macos-15 or macos-latest (macos-26) labels now.
top_signal.why_it_matters: macOS runners host iOS/macOS UI tests (XCUITest, Appium) and simulators—update workflow labels and validate toolchains to avoid CI failures and longer queue times.

items.title: EN 301 549 v4.1.1 adopts WCAG 2.2 — BrowserStack: prepare testing pipelines
items.summary: ETSI’s EN 301 549 v4.1.1 (adopting WCAG 2.2) raises interactive and platform-preference criteria. BrowserStack recommends integrated automated, semi-automated, and real-device testing for web and native apps.
items.why_it_matters: New success criteria require active interaction and real-device checks; QA must add WCAG 2.2 checks into CI and real-device suites to avoid regressions and procurement issues.

items.title: Actions retention now covers checks, workflow runs, and statuses
items.summary: Starting October 1, 2026, GitHub Actions retention settings apply to checks, workflow runs and statuses (default 90 days), aligning them with artifact/log retention and shortening historical availability.
items.why_it_matters: Flaky-test history, triage evidence and test-forensics windows shrink—QA leads must review retention, export or archive critical runs, and adjust policies before data is evicted.

items.title: Code coverage uploads no longer fail CI for new branches
items.summary: The GitHub Code Quality upload-code-coverage action no longer fails CI when pushing a branch that has no open pull request; it now skips uploads until a PR exists and explains why in the step summary.
items.why_it_matters: Eliminates false CI failures for new branches and reduces noisy broken pipelines—QA teams can simplify coverage workflows or add pull_request triggers for immediate uploads.

watch.title: GitHub Copilot 'computer use' (public preview) — Copilot can now interact with desktop apps
watch.summary: GitHub’s Copilot app now supports 'computer use' in public preview: it can read accessible UI content, click controls, type, scroll and drive GUI workflows on macOS and Windows (requires Accessibility + Screen Recording permissions).
watch.why_it_matters: Enables agentic automation for GUI-only and legacy apps—potentially useful for automating manual flows, but QA must validate reliability, permissions, and governance before adoption.

learning.title: Software Quality Assurance Tools and Tips for Developers — JetBrains (Qodana)
learning.summary: JetBrains Qodana post surveys SQA tools, shift-left practices, and practical tool choices across static analysis, unit/integration testing, performance tools, and CI integration for modern QA workflows.
learning.why_it_matters: A concise primer for QA leads building layered toolchains—shows how to integrate static analysis, coverage, and automated checks into CI and test strategy.
